recent_candidates.excerpt: View this post on the web at https://www.anarchonomicon.com/p/ep31-which-way-western-man-part-4 Chapter 3a (part 2) Jesus: Tribute and Re-Appraisal. Continuing our long series discussing and close reading “Which Way Western Man?” by William Gayley Simpson (1892-1990) The work that introduced Nietzsche to the American far-right and created much of the Far Right Vitilist, Pagan, Nietzschean, Racialist, and Eugenic though that defines the Far Right today. We will be following his personal/intellectual journey from Presbyterian Clergy to the Early ACLU to Franciscan Monkhood to Socialist Agitator to Zarathustran hermit to American Eugenicist and Racial-Nationalist. Joining me is Brynhildr/Vivienne Magdalene of the “For the Love of Nietzsche” Podcast [ https://substack.com/redirect/bf41385e-e85a-48ed-b48f-2b9a8be2d3f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMmpwdzcifQ.3xfUjhbxmXCecLGnlb_rhBXs-3STnTomTjes1rmBMMI ], who will be giving us her unique Nietzschean expertise.
